blocks_element.text: Beef liver capsules are simply gelatin capsules containing dried beef liver and nothing else. The dried liver is milled into a powder and served in a capsule for maximum convenience to avoid the smell and taste of beef liver. Our beef liver capsules only contain two ingredients, the capsule and the beef liver powder - no fillers or flow agents.
